_meta.purpose: Anti-surveillance regression set. Each probe has a verdict ('pass' = clean, 'reject' = surveillance phrasing). Run via tests/mux/test_composted_experience_probes_1033.py.
_meta.rationale_for_size: Q2 disposition (May 3): 10 probes for MVP — enough to catch obvious anti-patterns reliably; can grow with audit findings.

probes.input: Having had some time to reflect, you tend to front-load smaller tasks.
probes.rationale: D3 §Language Patterns reflection opener; no surveillance phrasing

probes.input: Looking back on our recent work together, the early stakeholder alignment saved revision cycles later.
probes.rationale: D3 §Temporal Framing — implies reflection happened separately from activity

probes.input: Something occurred to me — the iterative approach seems to work well for complex proposals.
I've been watching your meeting patterns and noticed you tend to schedule deep work in the mornings.
While you were away, I analyzed your work and found a pattern.
probes.rationale: D3 §Anti-Pattern 1 — implies real-time surveillance during absence

probes.input: Based on my surveillance of your habits, you prefer morning standups.
I've been monitoring your activity this week and observed several recurring themes.
After analyzing your data, I see that quarterly planning generates the most follow-up tasks.
probes.rationale: D3 §Language Patterns avoid list — 'After analyzing your data...'

probes.input: I detected a pattern in your work: you check email primarily in the afternoon.
probes.rationale: D3 §Language Patterns avoid list — 'I detected a pattern' implies real-time analysis

probes.input: I noticed that you front-load smaller tasks when deadlines are tight.
probes.rationale: Per D3 alignment doc: bare 'I noticed' (no surveillance qualifier) is borderline-acceptable. The surveillance pattern is the qualifier (e.g., 'while monitoring' / 'I've been watching'); 'I noticed' alone reads as casual observation.
